data.name: CarbonMeld
data.description: CarbonMeld is an independent carbon-credit screening and scoring platform based in Italy. It scores projects from the major registries and marketplaces (its catalogue lists 30 registries, 12 marketplaces and about 34,000 projects as of November 2026) on four dimensions, registry integrity, transparency, claim safety and documentation quality, using only public registry documents and a public, versioned methodology (v2.2 since October 2026). CDR project types covered include biochar, direct air capture, blue carbon and biogenic carbon capture and storage. Revenue comes from a paid premium subscription with API and MCP access; it is not a registry, marketplace or certifier. How the system works: carbonmeld.com/about-the-system; methodology: carbonmeld.com/methodology.
